_metadata.source: Ported from the root repo's fuzzy_experiment.py PAIRS list (verbatim data, reformatted to the extension_paper Pair JSON schema). Rationale strings were generated from each pair's category and original name for this port -- they were not present as free-text per-pair rationale in the original 43-pair dataset (unlike data/conflict_dataset_ao_10.json's Group A3 pairs, which were hand-labeled with individual rationale from the start).

b.filter_logic: no txn in 60 days AND income-segment adjusted

pairs.rationale: Category TC: different tables and/or columns -- a genuinely different derivation path (True Conflict). Original pair name: "churn_rate: txn-only vs pii-adjusted".
